scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to binary first-order Reed–Muller codes with odd \(m\ge3\). It determines all-symbol PIR multiplicity, not all-symbol batch multiplicity, and does not classify all extremal recovery families. The infinite lower bound uses the published exact partial-spread theorem; finite replay checks are corroborative. Literature searches cannot by themselves prove novelty.
title: Exact odd-dimensional all-symbol PIR multiplicity of binary first-order Reed–Muller codes
